sections.section: RULE - Fixed Amounts of Excise Duty on (Paints and Varnishes) Rules 1992
sections.description:
e
FIXED AMOUNTS
OF EXCISE DUTY ON (PAINTS AND VARNISHES) RULES, 1992
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 26th May, 1992]
S. R. O. 517(1)/92.‑‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) 'of section 37 of the
Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 (I of 1944), the Central Board of Revenue,
with the prior approval of the Federal Government, is pleased to make the
following rules for collection of fixed amounts of excise duty from the
manufacturers of paints and varnishes under Notification No.S.R.O. 515(1)/92,
dated the 26th May, 1992, namely:‑‑
1. Short title, application and commencement.‑‑‑(1) These
rules may be called the Fixed Amount of Excise Duty on (Paints and Varnishes)
Rules, 1992.
(2) They shall apply to the
establishment and undertakings specified in Notification NO.S.R.O.515(1)/92,
dated the 26th May, 1992.
(3) They shall come into force with immediate effect.
2. Definitions.‑‑‑(1) In these rules, unless there
is anything repugnant in
the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Act" means the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 (1 of
1944);
(b) "Association" means the Pakistan Paints Manufacturers
Association;
(c) "Authorised Officer" means an officer authorised under
these rules;
(d) "Joint Survey Committee" means Joint Survey Committee
under rule 3(2);
(e) "Manufacturer" means the manufacturer of paints and
varnishes; and
(f) "Notification" means the Central Board
of Revenue's Notification No.S.R.O. 515(1)/92, dated the 26th May, 1992.
(2) All other terms and expressions used. but not
defined in these‑ Rules shall have the same meanings as are assigned to
them in the Act.
3. Declaration to be
made.‑‑‑(1) The manufacturer liable to pay fixed amount of
central excise duty under the Notification shall make a declaration in writing
to the Assistant Collector of Central Excise of jurisdiction by 11‑6 1992,
for the financial year 1991‑92, and in respect of each subsequent
financial year by the 15th day of June of the year immediately preceding,
stating therein the number, make, model, size and capacity of each machine
installed in his factory meant for manufacturing paints and varnishes.
(2) The declaration shall be accompanied by a .copy
of the verified report of the Joint Survey Committee comprising of at least one
representative of the association, two officers of the Central Excise nominated
by the Collector having jurisdiction and the manufacturer himself or one of his
nominees.
4. Date from which the duty shall be payable.‑‑‑The
manufacturer subject to these rules, shall pay the monthly fixed amount of duty
specified in the notification referred to in clause‑(f) of sub‑rule
(1) of rule 2 at the rate applicable to them from the dates specified in cloumn
(4) of the Notification.
5. Amount of duty to be deposited in the treasury. ‑‑The
fixed amount of monthly central excise duty due from the dates specified in
cloumn (4) of the Notification shall be deposited by the manufacturers in the
Government treasury by 20‑6‑1992.
6. Notice of Demand.‑‑‑(1)
The Assistant Collector of Central Excise having jurisdiction shall deliver, to
a manufacturer by 18‑6‑1992, for the remaining period of 1991‑92
from the month indicated in the Notification, and in the month ‑ of July
for each subsequent year, a notice of demand for the amount of fixed central
excise duty due from the manufacture under the Notification, indicating both
the total amount of central excise duty payable during remaining period of 1991‑92,
and the amount of the monthly instalment.
(2) The fixed amount of duty
due for each month shall be deposited in lump sum by the manufacturer in the
Government treasury during the month to which it relates but not later the last
working day of month or it may be deposited in three equal instalments payable
as under;
(i) Each instalment, so payable, shall be not less
than one‑third of the fixed amount of sales tax paid in the month
preceding the month to which it relates;
(ii) the first instalment shall
be paid by the 11th day
